title: Quest reward bank
synopsis: Review quest lore and rewards, then allocate unused resources, asteroids, research and construction bonuses.
changes: Every supported quest displays its lore and reward before completion.
Claimed rewards enter a persistent bonus bank under Quests; resource and asteroid rewards are accepted explicitly.
Research and construction allocations support partial progress and multiple completions with budget and cap validation.
Staff article editor fills the module width, with bold, italic, font and size controls and a right-aligned publish button.

title: Staff news publishing
synopsis: Create categorized articles from the staff panel with dedicated icons and public archive links.
changes: Game admins can publish titles, synopses and article text to the central database.
Five update categories each have a theme icon on the editor, news cards and article pages.
Public portal and news archive display staff articles newest first; article text is rendered safely.

title: Draft orders and fleet delivery
synopsis: Build a multi-ship draft, confirm it with Order all, and choose where each ship is delivered.
changes: Ship cards separate Order now from Add to order.
Add to order saves a draft without charging resources; Order all validates and confirms the complete draft atomically.
Each ship has a Base / Fleet 1–3 delivery choice, applied when production finishes.
Drafts can be reviewed, removed or cleared and survive reloads.
Adaptive sidebar spacing, structured combat news and calculator import.
Round state ticker start, pause, step and speed controls for the browser practice round.
Alliance news has a distinct icon and theme accent in both signal lists; Quick actions preferences have quests.

title: Population and government ship production
synopsis: Running ship orders now apply population and government production bonuses with a manual lookup.
changes: Shipwright allocation and government output bonuses add together and immediately update active order rates and ETA.
Population includes a government selector and a linked manual lookup.
Democracy and Totalitarianism cost discounts apply to new ship orders without repricing paid orders.
Government changes use a 72-tick revolution production penalty.

title: Planet command header
synopsis: Your planet identity and current tick are grouped in a theme-matched top-right command box.
changes: Top-right box shows home coordinates, planet name, ruler and current tick.
The box updates after planet edits, relocation and tick progression, and adapts to narrow screens.
Whole-round reset also clears claimed quest rewards and restores quest progress to the default round.
Quest checkmarks follow claimed rewards and all clear when the round is reset.

title: Round state reset control
synopsis: Round state has a separate Reset round panel with an explicit confirmation.
changes: Round state includes a dedicated game-admin Reset round box.
Reset opens Are you sure? and requires typing RESET before the entire round is regenerated.
Apply changes buttons in the planet modules have improved theme contrast.

title: Complete round reset defaults
synopsis: A reset restores the default race, fleet catalogue and support panels correctly.
changes: Fresh rounds explicitly initialize race, galaxy fund, quest claims and news filters.
The shared directory normalizes fleet identifiers after a reset so the base fleet editor displays the correct ships.

title: Independent planet editor modules
synopsis: Each planet editor module applies its own changes without modifying other fields.
changes: Separate identity, location, alliance, resources, asteroids, base fleet, experience, structures and status modules.
Every module has an Apply changes button and its own confirmation status.
Applying one module preserves unsaved values in the other modules.

title: Portal account and round controls
synopsis: Registration, user profiles and staff controls join the portal navigation.
changes: Top navigation includes Shipstats and News, plus Register / Sign up for guests and User profile for signed-in commanders.
Admin-only staff controls list accounts and assign available planets.
Users can save their public name and portal theme through User profile.
Admin round reset clears and regenerates shared planets, alliances, intel, scans and browser news while preserving accounts and passwords.
Reset generations prevent stale clients from re-uploading scans from a previous round.

title: Admin alliance membership repair
synopsis: Admin-assigned planets now appear in the correct alliance roster, including after reload.
changes: Member rosters are reconciled with centrally assigned planets for every alliance.
Stable planet IDs retain roles across planet renames and remove memberships from the old alliance when moved.
Existing missing member records are repaired when loading the shared directory.

title: Version list and code references
synopsis: The v0.53.0 article now presents release changes as a dated version list with readable code references.
changes: The v0.53.0 news article uses a chronological version list, newest first.
Each version includes its change list and short code snippets with reference links.

title: Intel nicknames
synopsis: Alliance intel now supports nicknames and suggestions for members awaiting planet assignment.
changes: Nickname column provides a free-text box with suggestions for unassigned alliance members.
Nicknames are stored centrally for your alliance and follow intel edit and visible-field permissions.
Nickname labels do not change actual alliance membership or planet assignments.
Users can set their public game username beneath Planet display name; login credentials are unchanged.
Galaxy Browser Intel overlay mirrors alliance intel nickname, alliance, relation and scan columns in display-only mode.
Apply to order # assigns the chosen factories to the active ship order without resetting progress or changing queued orders.
codeSnippets:
// Apply factories to the active ship order
applyFactoriesToOrder(state.production.orderNumber);

title: Command news archive
synopsis: News cards now match Command Operations, with short briefings and a dated archive linking to full articles.
changes: Portal news posts use the same themed card layout as Command Operations.
Each news card includes a short synopsis and a link to its complete article.
The news archive lists releases by date, newest first, with version numbers.
Alliance Intel relations are read-only text, with War in bold red. The redundant Open Intel column is removed; planet names and scan letters open dossiers.
News cards include sci-fi background illustrations with dark overlays for readable text.
codeSnippets:
// Dated news articles are generated from release entries
newsPath(release); // /news-v0-52-0.html

title: Alliance intel and fleet launch
changes: Alliance dropdowns list all in-game alliances without changing actual membership.
Relation selectors color intel rows: Ally green, War red, NAP orange.
Latest available scans appear as linked type letters, respecting rank visibility.
Portal News posts and a versioned changelog added below Command Operations.
Fixed Fleet 1–3 launch selections; missions now move ships into outbound orders with ETA and return correctly.
Galaxy Scan uses radio buttons and All scans, charging once for the complete sweep of unlocked scan types.
synopsis: Alliance intel gains diplomatic colors and scan links; Fleet Launch is fixed and Galaxy Scan offers All scans.

title: Shared command network
changes: Central planet directory shared by the ordinary and alliance intel browsers.
Central alliance intel with rank permissions, visible field controls and galaxy overlay.
Version notification beneath the left game menu.
Alliance fund donation and exchange with 5% loss and minimum reserve controls.
Alliance statistics replace creation after founding; futuristic portal and manual styles.
synopsis: A shared planet directory, protected alliance intel and configurable rank visibility connect the command network.
codeSnippets:
// Load the shared planet directory
await centralDirectoryRequest("/api/planets");

title: Fleet reference
changes: Dedicated Shipstats manual page with race table colors, ship artwork and resource icons.
synopsis: The fleet reference adds a dedicated Shipstats page with race colors, ship artwork and resource icons.
